summary: Our team consists of enthusiastic and passionate members who are interested in science, technology, innovation, and space exploration. We participated in the NASA Space Apps Challenge with the aim of learning new things, sharing ideas, and developing innovative solutions to real-world problems. Each team member contributed their knowledge, creativity, and skills through teamwork and collaboration. This experience helped us improve our problem-solving, communication, and technical skills.
